edges.description: The application is built using React as its primary UI framework
The project uses TypeScript for type safety and component development
Styling is implemented using Tailwind CSS with custom theme configuration
The development build and server are powered by Vite
Navigation is handled via React Router DOM with Route-based page routing
Cart Context exemplifies the project's localStorage persistence pattern for cart and favorites state
Dark Mode exemplifies the project's localStorage persistence pattern for UI theme preferences
Chat Widget exemplifies the WhatsApp integration for customer support communication
The project's about section and chat widget are authored by and attribute content to Pai Rychelmy
Cart localStorage persistence claim is exemplified by the Cart Context implementation
Dark mode localStorage persistence claim is exemplified by the Dark Mode implementation
WhatsApp integration claim is exemplified by the Chat Widget component
